text: are born into greatness and all too often we get resigned into mediocrity because of the toxic information around us and maybe it's the people around us and maybe it's the information that we consume. Feeding your fire is the process and the habit of consistently only allowing the most useful information into your orbit. Feeding your fire is a protection mechanism or an idea which is you can't inspire people if you yourself are de-inspired feeding your fire is all about doing whatever it takes on a daily basis because your days are your life in miniature, and as you live each day, so you handcraft your life.
So Feeding Your Fire is about reading the heroic books that cause you to go deep and see how the great women, men of the world, did what they did.
